detail.longDescription: I am trying to clone https://github.com/monstercameron/pi-camera-gui onto my RPi 4B to use as a GUI for my camera. When I type git clone https://github.com/yourusernamehere/pi-camera-gui.git into terminal and hit enter it asks for username & password for https://github.com . Does it want my Github login or my Pi login? I wasn't sure so I put N/A as both and it came up with "remote: Invalid username or token. Password authentication is not supported for Git operations. fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/yourusernamehere/pi-camera-gui.git' Is this a scam? I've never had it ask for a username & password before.
